# Liquid Fill

**Cover › Organic** · v1.0.0 · 96 frames at 30 fps (48–150)

Blobs of liquid grow into cells with thin veins, the veins pinch away until the frame is one colour, then the next scene floods back in the same way.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/liquid-fill@1.0.0.mp4) · [Alpha overlay for editing apps](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/liquid-fill@1.0.0-overlay.mov)

## Where it is used

- Scene changes
- Section breaks
- Intros and outros
- Hiding a jump cut

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import liquidFill from './transitions/04-cover/organic/liquid-fill';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(liquidFill, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 96 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing. It draws with WebGL, so render with `--gl=angle` (GPU) or `--gl=swangle` (no GPU).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | color | `"#FF4F1A"` |  | The incoming scene's background colour; the transition brings it in. |
| `seed` | integer | `3` | 0–9999 | Blob layout. The reveal uses seed + 1. |
| `rows` | integer | `5` | 2–9 | Blobs across the frame height; more means smaller cells. |
| `from` | enum | `"random"` | `random` · `center` · `left` · `right` · `top` · `bottom` | Where the first blobs appear. |
| `gap` | number | `0.0085` | 0.002–0.03 | Half the vein width, as a fraction of frame height. |
| `wobble` | number | `0.012` | 0–0.04 | How much the liquid edge wobbles. |
| `hold` | number | `0.1` | 0–0.4 | Share of the transition spent fully covered. |
